notes: Robert Durden Color Slide Collection (SFP 42) — one enthusiast's colour slides of San Francisco streets, buildings and businesses, 1953-1994, filed on the photographer's own contact sheets by street, restaurant, theatre or church. Titles take the form "<business>, <number> <street>", which is the SFP 23 shape, so the default name policy applies rather than named-buildings-only.

coverage.remaining: None. The collection was read whole.
coverage.note: 288 records read; 67 give an exact street number; 218 give none and were skipped under COLLECTION_UNNUMBERED_POLICY, being street views and intersections; 1 was skipped as a photograph of people. 58 findings over 53 distinct addresses; 56 resolved, 2 unresolved (340 Linden, which EAS no longer holds, and 2120-2124 Union Street, a range now split across parcels).
